messages:
kevin-eng: @channel Announcing: Private HSM/KMS connector beta for VPC & on-prem installs. This lets customers integrate their HSM (PKCS#11) or cloud KMS (BYOK) for model encryption keys and audit-controlled key rotation. Beta invites going out next week. :key: :tada:

kevin-eng: Why this matters: some customers asked for tenant-controlled keys, FIPS-compatible flows, and automated rotation without handing us plaintext keys. This connector supports local HSMs (YubiHSM, Thales), PKCS#11 endpoints, and managed KMS endpoints (with mutual TLS).

sam-sales: Nice. Does this affect Dedicated / hosted customers or only Private? Need language for deal desks.

kevin-eng: Private-only for beta (VPC + on-prem). Dedicated customers can request a managed BYOK pilot; we'll treat that case-by-case with legal & infra.

anika-privacy: Legal/privacy summary: (1) No keys are persisted in plaintext on our control plane, (2) We added DPA language for BYOK/HSM connectors, (3) Rotation audit trail will be available as signed events. Customers requiring FedRAMP/IL5-level attestations should engage security review. I'll push an FAQ for Sales/CS within 48 hours.

sre-oncall: Architecture note: connector runs as an agent in-customer VPC or on-prem, talks to HSM over mTLS. Failure modes: if the connector loses connectivity we fall back to tenant-defined soft-keys (with explicit admin consent) to avoid app downtime. We'll provide metrics & alerts. No rolling restart of model servers required for connector install.

kevin-eng: Pilot timeline:
- Today: feature flag enabled on internal staging cluster.
- +7 days: pilot (5 customers) for in-depth validation of PKCS#11 workflows.
- +21 days: wider beta (invite-only).
- +45 days: GA if no major issues.

ops-bot: Runbook & install docs posted: https://redwood.dev/internal/runbooks/private-hsm-kms (internal). Install bot has a checklist.

install-bot: Example installer flags and CLI snippet:
```bash
# Install connector in "edge-ny" cluster and point to PKCS#11 endpoint
redwood private connector install --cluster edge-ny --connector hsm --pkcs11-endpoint https://10.0.1.12:8443 --mtls-cert ./certs/agent.pem

# Configure BYOK to use a managed KMS (mutual TLS required)
redwood private connector configure --deployment prod-eu --kms-type external --kms-endpoint https://kms.corp.example --auth-mode mtls
```
Note: the installer will validate connectivity and will refuse to store private keys on our control plane.

sam-sales: Any customer-facing materials yet? I want a 2-sentence elevator pitch and a slide deck for AE enablement.

anika-privacy: I'll drop the legal blurb and 2-sentence pitch in the sales kit. Also adding Q&As about rotation windows and key escrow.

kevin-eng: SRE note: metric names and alerts created: private.hsm.connector.up, private.hsm.rotation.success, private.hsm.rotation.failed. We'll add dashboard templates to Console -> Private -> Security.

ops-bot: Beta deployment window: 2026-06-07 01:00-03:00 UTC (connector rollout to invited clusters only).

kevin-eng: Action items:
- @sre-oncall: finalize dashboard templates and alert runbooks (ETA 3 days).
- @anika-privacy: publish Sales/CS FAQ + legal blurb (ETA 48h).
- @sam-sales: send list of top 10 prospects who asked for BYOK (ETA 72h).
- @kevin-eng: ship pilot invites and internal demo (ETA 5 days).

sre-oncall: Acknowledged, will also add failure-mode playbook to the runbook.

sam-sales: On it, will DM the list and book an enablement slot.

kevin-eng: Thanks team. If anyone wants to join pilot testing or needs early access to the installer, DM me. We'll post a short public-facing note when GA is confirmed. :rocket:
